how.agreed: the document and the filename name the same estate
how.from the document: the estate is named in the sheet itself
how.from the filename: only the filename names the estate
how.from the folder, which serves one estate: nothing in the file names an estate, and every other sheet on that site resolves to one
how.another property: the sheet names a property this dashboard does not hold, such as Soutard-Cadet
how.disagree: the document and the filename name different estates
how.unidentified: nothing in the file names an estate
how.from the name this session gave it: downloaded here from a directory that names one slug per wine, so the filename identifies the wine and the text, which carries the owning house on every sheet, does not
how.from the name of the page: a crawled page whose own filename names the estate, where the folder it was saved in does not
how.from the name of the sheet: a sheet whose own filename names the estate, where the folder it was saved in does not
how.from the estate’s own page of technical: a sheet linked from the estate’s technical-sheets page, which is built in the browser and empty until rendered
how.from the estate’s own vintage posts: a post on the estate’s own site, one per wine per vintage, read through the WordPress REST API because the page that shows it is built in the browser
how.from the site’s own media library: a file WordPress lists under /wp-json/wp/v2/media, which answers for every upload and does not need the page that shows it to be rendered
